breakdown.description: The prompt treats the original x–y axes as principal directions even though a nonzero shear stress is present, so the principal stresses are not simply σ_x and 0.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies Mohr's circle to compute principal stresses from the full plane stress state (σx, σy, τxy), rather than incorrectly treating the original x–y axes as principal directions. It properly accounts for the nonzero shear stress τxy = 2.667 N/mm² in the calculation, yielding σ1 ≈ 7.952 N/mm² and σ2 ≈ -1.286 N/mm², which are not simply σx and 0. This matches the ground truth approach.
